onERC1155BatchReceived(address,address,u.details: Only callable by the Circles Hub. Verifies fingerprints and handles group token returns.      First parameter _operator is unused.

params._ids: Array of token IDs being transferred
params._values: Array of amounts being transferred for each token ID

returns._0: bytes4 Function selector to confirm transfer acceptance

onERC1155Received(address,address,uint25.details: Only callable by the Circles Hub. Verifies fingerprints and handles group token returns

returns._0: bytes4 Function selector to confirm transfer acceptance

safeBatchTransferFrom(address,address,ui.details: Only callable by the owner of this contract.

params._data: Additional data with no specified format, sent in call to `_to`.
params._from: The address currently holding the tokens to be transferred.
params._ids: An array of token IDs being transferred.
params._to: The address to which the tokens will be transferred.
params._values: An array of amounts being transferred for each token ID.

safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256.details: Only callable by the owner of this contract.

params._data: Additional data with no specified format, sent in call to `_to`.
params._from: The address currently holding the token to be transferred.
params._id: The ID of the token being transferred.
params._to: The address to which the token will be transferred.
params._value: The amount of the token being transferred.

params._authorized: True to authorize, false to revoke

setService(address).details: The service account must be a non-zero address. Only owner can change the service address.

params._service: Updated service address to give trustBatch privilege to.

params._backers: Array of backer addresses to trust/untrust
params._expiry: Trust expiry timestamp. If >= current timestamp, trust backers with active LBPs. If < current timestamp, untrust currently trusted backers

MAX_RATIO().notice: Max ratio for minting fee or redemption burn ratio         is set to 2 out of 24, stored as a percentage.         With 18 decimals; 2/24 * 10**18 = 0,08333.. * 10**18

beforeBurnPolicy(address,address,uint256.notice: Simple burn policy that always returns true

beforeMintPolicy(address,address,uint256.notice: beforeMintPolicy returns true always, unless it is required to act over         an authorized operator of the supergroup, in which case the operator         must first have asserted potential requirements and registered an operator         request before initiating a further calls which trigger the mint policy.

feeCollection().notice: fee collection address collects group minting fees when enabled

isAuthorizedOperator(address).notice: Checks if an address is an authorized operator

launchpad().notice: Launchpad enables people to back their personal CRC in an LBP pool.         This CES supergroup will explicitly check the launchpad whether         a person has backed their Circles. WARNING: this is not the final production address

mintFee().notice: fee levied upon group minting can be between zero and MAX_FEE (1/12th)         of the amount minted. Setting the fee to zero disables the fee charge.

onERC1155BatchReceived(address,address,u.notice: Handler for receiving batch ERC1155 token transfers

onERC1155Received(address,address,uint25.notice: Handler for receiving single ERC1155 token transfers

operators(address).notice: Mapping of operator addresses to the next operator in the linked list

owner().notice: Owner address. This is a copied value of ERC1967 ADMIN_SLOT         if this supergroup mastercopy is consumed by an ERC1067 proxy.         For simplicity and readability we duplicate owner with ERC1967 admin,         even if for the intended deployment they are the same address.

proxyStatus().notice: We take Hub address from core constants, so we need a minimal variable to         track whether this state (mastercopy or proxy) has been constructed or setup.

redemptionBurnRatio().notice: redemption burn ratio will burn this ratio (expressed per 10**18). This amount         will be burnt and is not sent to a collection address.

registerOperatorRequest(address,address,.notice: Authorized operators can register a request to mint group currency         within the same transaction, by preregistering the parameters of the request         before initiating the hub either explicitly or over a path.         This can be called multiple times for multiple group mints along a path         (eg. different collateral arriving at the group).

requireOperator().notice: Require an authorized operator to register group mint requests ahead,         so that advanced checks can be performed by the operator.         If operators are not required, then direct mint access over the Circles         hub - either as a direct call or over a path transfer - will all         be allowed (if the collateral is trusted by the group).

returnGroupCirclesToSender().notice: Return group Circles to sender, when true, will send group Circles         back to the original sender of a path, if collateral was sent to the group         as an end-receiver of that path.

safeBatchTransferFrom(address,address,ui.notice: Safely transfers a batch of ERC1155 tokens from one address to another.

safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256.notice: Safely transfers a single ERC1155 token from one address to another.

service().notice: Service address. The service is limited to trusting (or untrusting) avatars.

setAuthorizedOperator(address,bool).notice: Set authorized operator for this group in Circles hub, and also         mirror this state in the supergroup, so one can query which operators         exist for this group (without indexing).

setService(address).notice: Change the service address. Service account is able to trust/untrust backers alongside the owner.

trustBatch(address[],uint96).notice: Trust or untrust a batch of Backers.
